input.headline: Kenya: Government-appointed taskforce issues report recommending blockchain and AI to fight corruption, boost state transparency and uphold human rights in emerging-technology adoption.

input_full.excerpt: This report provides the government with a strategic course on how to develop a roadmap to uphold human rights when adopting emerging technologies like AI. The report recommends how to leverage blockchain and AI to combat corruption and augment state transparency.
